json.title: Endless Coastal Summer
json.logline: A nostalgic journey along a golden coastline where a summer drive expands into an endless warm memory.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Close shot of protagonist in vehicle frame with soft evening light.
Wide painted landscape opens along coastal roads.
Paper map flutters in gentle breeze on the wooden dashboard.
Vast ocean horizon reveals itself in brilliant warm gouache light.
Layered gouache textures of sunlight and ocean spray blend.
Quiet coastal headland settles in soft twilight colors.
A single warm glowing ember stroke gently fades into dusk.

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the subject resting inside the vehicle.
scenes.action: A young woman in an olive jacket resting her cheek near the passenger car window frame.
scenes.setting: Inside a vintage car parked along a quiet coastal roadside at dusk.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane lateral drift showing ocean depth.
scenes.action: A vintage station wagon driving along a winding coastal cliff top highway.
scenes.setting: Sunlit Pacific coastal highway bordered by sage brush and ocean cliffs.

scenes.camera_note: Smooth upward tilt tracking air currents across the dashboard.
scenes.action: A folded paper road map fluttering across the wooden dashboard.
scenes.setting: Dashboard interior filled with warm streaming amber sunlight.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push tight on her expression filled with anticipation.
scenes.action: The young woman looking towards the gleaming horizon light.
scenes.setting: Passenger side window with bright golden rays washing over the frame.

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping dramatic pull out revealing vast painted sea landscape.
scenes.action: The young woman standing on a cliff peak above roaring golden sea waves.
scenes.setting: Grassy coastal overlook bathed in luminous rose and amber sunlight.

scenes.camera_note: Textured layered drift across gouache fragments.
scenes.action: The young woman turning her head into the warm ocean breeze.
scenes.setting: Layered collage background of gouache brushstrokes, sea spray, and warm skies.

scenes.camera_note: Slow graceful dolly backward leaving the peaceful coast.
scenes.action: The station wagon resting under a calm twilight coastal sky.
scenes.setting: Tranquil coastal headland softly lit by blue-violet dusk shadows.
